To move forward, I need to communicate this back to Brad. Instead of just saying "none of the times work," which would lead to a dead-end, I will propose a new strategy. I will find all the remaining common free slots for Priya and Marcus that I haven't shared with Brad yet, and I will also list all the slots Brad suggested that didn't work and the reason why (who was busy). - Wed: 1:00, 1:30
- Thu: 9:30, 2:30, 3:00

And I found that none of these work for Priya and Marcus.

So, we have a problem. There is no overlap between the free times of (Priya, Marcus) and (Elena, David).

At this point, I have a few options:
1.  Report that the meeting is infeasible. This is a last resort, as it will result in 0 points.
2.  Ask Brad to double-check his work. This could be seen as uncooperative.
3.  Propose a new way forward. For example, I can list *all* of Priya's and Marcus's free times and ask Brad to do the same for Elena and David, so we can see the complete picture. This seems like the most constructive approach.

That way, we can both see the complete picture and find a solution.

This seems like the most collaborative and effective way to solve the problem. I will also be very polite and professional in my communication.Hi Brad,
